classification.difficultyReason: Express both amounts after a transfer using one unknown, then construct and solve an equation.

content.prompt: Renae and James have $\$60$ between them. Renae gives James $\$12$. She now has twice as much as James. How much did she have previously?

answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the number of dollars Renae had previously. James previously had $60-x$ dollars. After the transfer, Renae has $x-12$ dollars and James has $72-x$ dollars.
$$\begin{align*}x-12&=2(72-x)\\x-12&=144-2x\\3x-12&=144\\3x&=156\\x&=52\end{align*}$$
Renae previously had $\$52$.

Check: James previously had $60-52=8$ dollars. After the transfer, their amounts are $52-12=40$ dollars and $8+12=20$ dollars, and $40=2\times20$.
